claim that neutral dressing changes particle number

conjectures.statement: Specify a common native 100-state pair plus separate vacuum, both doublet/output choices, prepared scalar pair, and the same neutral record/reference for both rules.
conjectures.acceptance: Explicit maps, metrics, vacuum and preparation. Record all supplied laws; no physical interpretation inferred.

conjectures.statement: Transport both signed controlled involutions to Pi=J Ps Jdagger; derive the complete uniform-generator Hamiltonian, including its scalar diagonal.
conjectures.acceptance: Exact involution, metric, cycle-covariance and native-complement controls; preserve source hashes.

conjectures.statement: Construct the same signed-record law with control c-Pi, keeping its vacuum control zero and all other input/resource parameters identical.
conjectures.acceptance: No changed baseline or removed complementary records; same Hilbert space and reference as primary.

conjectures.statement: Both complete Hamiltonians retain their diagonal terms, neutral record preparation and one common empty-reference subtraction.
conjectures.acceptance: Bounded/self-adjoint finite construction, total energy accounting and joint reversibility; no arbitrary species offset.

conjectures.statement: Classify exactly which number/charge sectors each rule preserves or changes; do not call neutral dressing annihilation.
conjectures.acceptance: Exact sector operator tests and a separately stated variable-phase contract. No inferred physical photons.

conjectures.statement: At a frozen common preparation and model-unit evolution time, enclose neutral occupation and full joint energy/readout for both rules and establish a distinguishing prediction.
conjectures.acceptance: Exact or certified bounds must distinguish rules under identical preparation, record pool and reference; retain measurement effect and post-readout state.

conjectures.statement: Assemble one source-addressed retained-reaggregation comparison satisfying all frozen interface, covariance, reference and discriminator obligations.
conjectures.acceptance: A scoped fresh checker/written proof certificate addressing the complete target, with source/dependency hashes; components alone do not promote this target.

conjectures.statement: Identify a physical native interaction and preparation/readout that select or reject a reaggregation rule, with independent physical scale and coupling evidence.
conjectures.acceptance: New explicit physical/design/observational input and discriminating consequences. Conditional constructor success and fitting 372 are insufficient.

issue_registry.meaning: scope/backlog crosslinks, not prerequisite truth claims or automatically resolved outcomes

dependency_semantics: Chosen constructive route only; readiness does not prove a target, and rejection of one route does not refute all other mechanisms.
outcome_policy: ++ proves the scoped proposition; -+ refutes it; +- and -- are unsuccessful attempts with unresolved truth. These are not static polarity arrows. Every attempt is retained. No attempt-budget reset or dependent promotion.

admission_policy.meaning: Authoritative append-only hash-chained ledger; resolved outcomes require theorem-specific fresh admission. Contract node outcomes are initial snapshots, not editable certificates.

planner.meaning: Only dependency readiness is computed. No invented probabilities, EU estimates or Nima budget transfer.

history_policy: Initial snapshots remain null; derive outcomes from append-only ledger. Preserve all attempts, pauses and consumed budget; no independent retries or reset.
terminal_policy: Only admitted target ++ or -+ resolves the conditional objective. Ledger exhaustion and failed attempts do not refute it; physical admission stays separately unresolved.
evidence_failure_policy: Block on stale/missing/out-of-root evidence. No silent repinning, no evidence-file refresh or scientific outcome by this checker.
